transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well… I guess I’m here because of some family stress. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it’s been bothering me for a while.

It’s about my husband’s sister and the family business. I feel like she’s been working things so she can get control of the money and push me out of decisions. Other people try to smooth it over, but… I know what I’ve been seeing, and it’s been going on for more than a year now.
Have you ever felt that people who are close to you, like your husband or other family members, were involved in a plot or conspiracy against you?

I don’t know if I’d call it a whole conspiracy, doctor… that sounds kind of strong. But yes, I do feel like my husband’s sister has been working things with the family business to get control of the money and push me out of decisions. Other folks keep trying to smooth it over, like I’m misunderstanding, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on for more than a year now.
Do you find yourself mistrusting other people in areas of your life outside of this situation with your husband’s sister?

No, not really… I mean, I try not to be suspicious of everybody. I still go to my quilting group and choir practice, and I’ve been keeping up with my GED lessons and those senior walks like I always have.

Mostly it’s just changed how much I trust my husband’s sister, and maybe which family gatherings I feel comfortable going to. I hope that makes sense.
Do you believe that your husband’s sister’s actions toward you are definitely happening, even though others say you’re misunderstanding, and do you feel certain about this despite no clear proof?

Yes… I mean, I don’t want to sound unreasonable, but yes, I do feel sure it’s happening. She’s been working things with the family business so she can get control of the money and push me out of decisions.

Other people say I’m misunderstanding or try to smooth it over, and I know I don’t have some paper that proves it all clearly… but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on for more than a year now.
Have you ever experienced any strange sensations or perceptions, like hearing voices, seeing things that others don’t, or feeling sensations on your skin without a clear cause?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, not like hearing voices or seeing things that aren’t there. I haven’t noticed anything like bugs on my skin or strange sensations either.

I hope that’s the kind of thing you mean—I don’t want to answer it wrong.

Would you say your belief about your husband’s sister trying to take control of the family business and push you out of decisions is something you feel absolutely certain about, even though others don’t share that view?

Yes… I suppose I would say I’m certain, though I know that may sound strong. I’m not trying to make trouble or accuse her for no reason.

It’s just that with the family business and the money decisions, I can see how she’s been working things so I get pushed out. Other people try to smooth it over or tell me I’m reading it wrong, but I know what I’ve been seeing, and it’s been going on for more than a year. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you know other people might find strange or hard to believe?

Well… I guess some people might find it hard to believe, yes. I don’t mean it in some wild way, and I’m not trying to make trouble.

It’s just why I came in, really—my husband’s sister has been working things in the family business so she can get control of the money and push me out of decisions. Folks try to smooth it over and tell me I’m taking it wrong, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on for more than a year now. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever believed in something that you know most people would think is completely impossible or not based in reality at all?

I wouldn’t say it’s completely impossible, no… I mean, to me it’s based on what’s been happening.

I know other people might think I’m making too much of it, and I don’t want to sound unreasonable. But I came because my husband’s sister has been working things in the family business so she can get control of the money and push me out of decisions. People keep trying to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing, and it’s been going on for more than a year now. Is that what you’re asking?

Even though others have told you that you may be misinterpreting the situation with your husband's sister, and there's no clear proof, do you still feel completely certain that she is trying to take over the family business and push you out?

Yes… I do still feel sure about it. I know that may sound stubborn, and I don’t want you to think I’m just trying to blame her.

But I came because my husband’s sister has been working this family business in a way that gets her control of the money and leaves me out of decisions. People keep trying to smooth it over or say I’m taking it wrong, but… I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on for more than a year now.
Has this belief about your husband’s sister affected any other parts of your life, like your relationship with your husband or other family members, your work, or your daily activities?

A little, I suppose… not like I can’t function or anything. I still keep up with my normal routines, and I go to church and all that.

I have skipped a few family get-togethers, though. It just feels easier sometimes than having things get stirred up. And I don’t share certain plans or money matters the way I used to, because I don’t want them getting back to my husband’s sister. I hope that makes sense—I’m not trying to be difficult.

Even though there’s no clear proof and others don’t share your view, has your belief that your husband’s sister is trying to take control of the family business remained completely unchanged over this entire time?

I wouldn’t say I’ve changed my mind, no. I mean… I try to listen when people say maybe I’m reading it wrong, because I don’t want to be unfair.

But honestly, it still looks the same to me. I came because my husband’s sister has been working things in the family business so she can get control of the money and push me out of decisions. Folks try to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing, and it’s been more than a year now.
Even though you’ve had time to think about it and others have told you you might be misunderstanding, do you feel your belief about your husband’s sister is absolutely true, without any doubt at all?

I… yes, I do feel it’s true. I don’t want to sound unreasonable, and I know people keep saying maybe I’m taking it the wrong way, but I don’t really have doubt about what I’ve been seeing.

I came because my husband’s sister has been working this family business so she can get control of the money and push me out of decisions. Folks try to smooth it over, but it’s been going on for more than a year now, and I know what I’ve seen.
